items.headline: Browns and Saints try to stay close to their division leaders as they meet in New Orleans
items.description: — The Cleveland Browns are two games above .500 but find themselves in third place in the AFC North and seeking a victory to keep pace with first-place Pittsburgh and second-place Cincinnati.

items.headline: Saints' Jordyn Tyson returns to practice, listed as limited participant
items.description: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson took a major step toward making his season debut Wednesday, returning to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.
